{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)

# Report findings
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Patient IDs with duplicates: {list(duplicate_patients)}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df["biomarker_baseline"].eq(-999).sum()}')

# Check biomarker_final values in batch B
batch_b_values = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']
print(f'Batch B biomarker_final min: {batch_b_values.min()}, max: {batch_b_values.max()}')"}
